summary: NIP Group Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting the resignation of Director and Financial Director Yanjun Xu, effective June 30, 2026. The filing explicitly states that the resignation is not due to any disagreement with the company regarding operations, policies, or practices. No other terms, prices, or advisor details are provided. The departure of the Financial Director is a management change event. The next steps to watch are the appointment of a replacement and whether this signals broader board or leadership shifts.
